description.zh: Auto Windows 项目的 DSH 插件（Windows 操控与安全审批）
description.en: DSH plugins from the Auto Windows project (Windows control & safety approval)

description.zh: 对 Auto Windows MCP 的高危工具（run_powershell/fs_write/fs_move/fs_delete/proc_kill/reg_write/sandbox_restore）弹出 DSH 原生审批卡片，拒绝时调用不到达 MCP Server。实测 DSH 标准模式原生审批不拦 MCP 工具，本插件是唯一屏障。
description.en: Client-side approval gate for high-risk Auto Windows MCP tools via tools/pre-execute ask decisions; blocked calls never reach the MCP server.
